verification_gates.name: backend pytest
verification_gates.command: cd backend && uv run pytest -n 8 --dist loadscope --no-header -q --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider

verification_gates.name: n8n workflow json validity
verification_gates.command: cd backend && python -c "import json; json.load(open('../n8n/Trackpal WhatsApp Bot.json', encoding='utf-8')); print('valid')"

items.description: Extend the backend WhatsApp console API contract for contextual routing and silent responses.
steps: Add request fields for from_me, admin_phone, admin_jid, target_jid, target_phone, and target_lid while preserving existing phone, message, instance, and sender_lid behavior.
Add response fields reply_to and no_reply while preserving existing serialization behavior for reply, status, lookup_job_id, and tenant_id.
Add or update endpoint tests proving new fields are accepted and serialized without breaking existing legacy requests.
items.regression_notes: New request fields from_me, admin_phone, admin_jid, target_jid, target_phone, target_lid accepted without breaking legacy. New response fields reply_to, no_reply serialized conditionally. 32/32 endpoint tests pass.

items.description: Add persistent Client Messaging Block storage and service behavior for unregistered WhatsApp identities.
steps: Add a tenant-scoped database model and Alembic migration for Client Messaging Blocks with phone, LID, active state, and timestamps, requiring at least one identity field.
Add repository/service functions to create, list, find active, unblock, and clear blocks for a tenant identity without creating Client rows.
Add backend tests proving blocks are tenant-scoped, require phone or LID, are persistent until unblocked, and are cleared when a Client is successfully created for the blocked identity.
items.regression_notes: Model + migration added. Repository: create, list_active, find_active, unblock, clear_identity. 32/32 repository tests pass. Blocks are tenant-scoped, require phone or LID, persist until unblocked, cleared on Client creation. 1133/1133 full test suite passes.

items.description: Implement unauthenticated client-side code lookup for unregistered identities with Client Messaging Block enforcement.
steps: Route unregistered identities in a known tenant instance to code lookup only when they send codigo, código, or code.
Return no_reply=true for blocked unregistered identities on codigo, /menu, or any other client-side console attempt.
Preserve existing registered Client profile/subscription behavior and ensure inactive Clients do not fall back to unauthenticated code lookup.
Add tests proving unregistered code lookup asks for service then email, sends lookup replies to the requester, and blocked attempts stay silent.
items.regression_notes: Unregistered identities routed to code lookup on codigo/código/code in known tenant instances. Blocked identities receive no_reply=true. Existing registered Client behavior preserved. Session-managed multi-step flow: service selection → email → lookup job creation. 5 new endpoint tests pass. 1138/1138 full test suite passes. Frontend builds clean. n8n workflow JSON valid.

items.description: Implement instance-first contextual routing for outgoing from_me=true /menu triggers.
steps: When from_me=true and target equals the admin chat, route to the standard Tenant console.
When from_me=true and target differs from the admin chat, route to the Client Context Shortcut and include reply_to as admin_jid.
Use admin_phone when present and fall back to the tenant owner resolved by instance when admin_phone is missing.
Reject a new contextual trigger privately via reply_to when another context is already active.
Add endpoint tests for target-equals-admin, target-differs, owner fallback, reply_to, and active-context collision.
items.regression_notes: from_me routing implemented with self-target (phone/JID match), non-self-target routing to shortcut with reply_to=admin_jid, owner fallback when admin_phone absent via tenant.whatsapp_phone, active context collision returns no_reply=true with reply_to. 7 new endpoint tests pass. 1145/1145 full test suite passes. Frontend builds clean. n8n workflow JSON valid.

items.description: Implement Client Context Shortcut session lifecycle and unregistered target menus.
steps: Store contextual state under wa:client_ctx:{admin_phone} with a 5-minute TTL independent of session:admin:{phone}.
Route private bot-chat messages to the contextual facade before the regular Tenant console while contextual state exists.
Show unregistered unblocked targets Crear cliente, Bloquear mensajes, and 0 Cancelar; show blocked targets Desbloquear mensajes and 0 Cancelar.
Create blocks immediately without confirmation or reason, unblock from the shortcut, close context after completed actions, and abort at any depth on 0.
Add service tests for menus, TTL behavior, invalid input not refreshing TTL, completed action cleanup, and 0 cleanup.
items.regression_notes: Context sessions stored under wa:client_ctx:{admin_phone} with 5-minute TTL. Admin messages routed to context facade before Tenant console when context active. Unblocked unregistered targets show Crear cliente, Bloquear mensajes, 0 Cancelar. Blocked targets show Desbloquear mensajes, 0 Cancelar. Block creation immediate without confirmation. Unblock from shortcut with find_active then unblock. 0 closes context at any depth. Invalid input does not refresh TTL. 10 new endpoint tests pass. 1155/1155 full test suite passes. Frontend builds clean. n8n workflow JSON valid.

items.description: Implement contextual Client creation and existing Client management flows.
steps: For unregistered targets, start Client creation with phone prefilled when target_phone exists and ask for phone when only target_lid exists.
For existing active Clients, expose Tenant console client detail actions except phone editing, plus Create subscription with client selection skipped.
For existing inactive Clients, expose reactivate, delete when eligible, and edit allowed fields except phone; hide Create subscription until reactivated.
Ensure inactive Clients count as existing identities and cannot be duplicated by contextual creation.
Add service tests for phone skip, LID-only phone prompt, active menu/actions, inactive menu/actions, blocked phone edit, and subscription shortcut.
items.regression_notes: Creating flow (phone skip, LID-only prompt) implemented. Active/inactive client menus, edit (except phone), deactivate/reactivate, delete, subscription shortcut. Inactive clients prevent duplicate creation. 5 new endpoint tests pass. 1160/1160 full test suite passes. Frontend builds clean. n8n workflow JSON valid.

items.description: Add regular Tenant console management for Client Messaging Blocks and correct Clients submenu back behavior.
steps: Update the Clients menu to show 1 Ver clientes, 2 Crear cliente, 3 Bloqueos de mensajes, and 9 Volver al menú principal.
Add a Clients-section flow to list active Client Messaging Blocks and unblock a selected identity.
Align Clients flow handlers so 9 is the submenu back command where the UI says 9 and 0 is not treated as the Clients-menu back command.
Add Tenant console service tests for block list, unblock, empty list, and 9 back behavior.
items.regression_notes: Clients menu shows 1 Ver clientes, 2 Crear cliente, 3 Bloqueos de mensajes, 9 Volver al menú principal. Block list, unblock, and 9-back behavior implemented in clients_flow.py. 9 from clients menu returns to main menu (0 exits globally). 8 new service tests pass. 1168/1168 full test suite passes. Frontend builds clean. n8n workflow JSON valid.

items.description: Update the n8n WhatsApp Bot workflow for contextual payloads, reply_to routing, and no_reply silence.
steps: Update the Parse input node to extract fromMe, admin_jid, target_jid, target_phone, and target_lid without deriving phones from @lid values.
Update the Console Call node JSON body to send the new backend request fields.
Update merge/routing nodes so reply_to and no_reply are preserved, send nodes use reply_to when present, and no Evolution send occurs when no_reply=true.
Validate the workflow JSON and add any available bounded workflow contract tests or documented manual validation evidence.

items.description: Refresh project documentation for the implemented WhatsApp shortcut, blocks, contracts, and workflow behavior.
steps: Update relevant architecture and codebase docs under docs/ to describe Client Context Shortcut routing, Client Messaging Blocks, unauthenticated code lookup, reply_to, and no_reply.
Update backend and n8n contract docs so future maintainers can reproduce the payload and response behavior.
Ensure docs/SUMMARY.md links any new or changed durable docs needed by maintainers.
Run all verification gates after documentation changes.
